description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [ATK, MAG and MND 30%, DEF and RES 25% (25s)], [Quick Cast] and [Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] to all allies, grants [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Minfilia] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Minfilia
description.text: Cast speed x1.10 for Support or Knight abilities, casts Spirit Attack: Minfilia after using two Support or Knight abilities (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Entrusted Will+
description.text: Transfers the user's Soul Break points to the target (maximum of 500 Soul Break points), grants [Instant Cast 1]

description.name: Spirit Attack: Minfilia
description.text: Causes [Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)], [Buff Prismatic 10% (15s)] and [200% ATB 1] if 0-3/4+ XIV allies are alive

description.name: ATK, MAG and MND 30%, DEF and RES 25% (25s)
description.text: ATK, MAG and MND 30%, DEF and RES 25%

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
